title.en: Seedance 2.5 — longer video with multimodal references
title.zh: Seedance 2.5 — 更长视频与多模态参考

summary.en: Seedance 2.5 video generation is available on OmniMux.
summary.zh: Seedance 2.5 视频生成已在 OmniMux 可调用。

body.en:
## Seedance 2.5

**Seedance 2.5** is now available on OmniMux for async video generation.

### New model

- **Model ID:** `seedance-2-5`
- **Create:** `POST /v1/video/generations`
- **Poll:** `GET /v1/video/generations/{task_id}`
- **Highlights:** longer single-pass generation and multimodal reference inputs (text / image / video / audio style workflows)

Pin the exact ID from live pricing before integrating.
body.zh:
## Seedance 2.5

**Seedance 2.5** 现已在 OmniMux 可调用（异步视频生成）。

### 新模型

- **模型 ID：** `seedance-2-5`
- **创建：** `POST /v1/video/generations`
- **查询：** `GET /v1/video/generations/{task_id}`
- **要点：** 更长单次生成，支持多模态参考输入（文本 / 图像 / 视频 / 音频类工作流）

接入前请以线上定价的精确 ID 为准。

title.en: MiniMax H3 — text-to-video and frame variants

summary.en: MiniMax H3 video routes are live on OmniMux.

body.en:
## MiniMax H3

**MiniMax H3** video models are now available on OmniMux.

### New models

| Model ID | Role |
| --- | --- |
| `minimax-h3` | Standard text/image-to-video |
| `minimax-h3-t2v` | Text-to-video |
| `minimax-h3-flf` | First/last-frame style I2V |
| `minimax-h3-fl2va` | FL2VA-oriented path |
| `minimax-h3-endframe` | End-frame reference I2V |

### API

- **Create:** `POST /v1/video/generations`
- **Poll:** `GET /v1/video/generations/{task_id}`

Async only — submit once, then poll task status.
body.zh:
## MiniMax H3

**MiniMax H3** 视频模型现已在 OmniMux 可调用。

### 新模型

| 模型 ID | 角色 |
| --- | --- |
| `minimax-h3` | 标准文/图生视频统一路由 |
| `minimax-h3-t2v` | 文生视频 |
| `minimax-h3-flf` | 首末帧类 I2V |
| `minimax-h3-fl2va` | FL2VA 路径 |
| `minimax-h3-endframe` | 尾帧参考 I2V |

### 调用

- **创建：** `POST /v1/video/generations`
- **查询：** `GET /v1/video/generations/{task_id}`

异步任务：提交后轮询状态。
